title: Fish fries, speakeasies and harmonica
summary: Fish fries without permits, speakeasies in prohibition and the origin of the term, then a harmonica question.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition

Oh, we played fish fry down. Plenty of fish fry. Oh, man. That's good days, fish fry. And what made it so nice, you know what I mean? You hear the police come and you have to jump the back fence.
How come were you making too much noise or something?
